name: Zechariah (priest with trumpet)
title: Priest in Nehemiah's dedication procession
summary: Zechariah was one of the priests who blew trumpets during the dedication of Jerusalem's wall in Nehemiah's time, in the great thanksgiving procession around the wall.

keyEvents.title: Blows trumpet at the wall dedication
keyEvents.description: Zechariah was among the priests with trumpets in the procession when Jerusalem's wall was dedicated.
